positions.title: Information Technology Helpdesk
positions.description:
As an IT helpdesk assistant, I work in the Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Library providing remote and in-person assistance with computer problems. I make sure to provide excellent customer service to staff & faculty, while at the same time informing them about internet security. 

     - Assist in all IT areas of responsibility including hardware & software installations.
     - Automated part of our imaging workflow, using a Python script, to cut down our workflow time by 40%.
     - Provided excellent customer service in understanding a client's issue and resolving it to their satisfaction.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
Our mission is to make education more accessible and inclusive to everyone. We create roadmaps for lifelong learners and those who aspire to become one. Check out https://npath.io/ to see our website!

Responsibilities:
- Developing the REST API using NodeJS and ExpressJS.
- Created and maintaining the app's PostgreSQL database.
- Bridging the front-end code to the back-end.

positions.title: Google CodeU Participant
positions.description:
CodeU is an invitation-only program designed to provide students with practical experience in collaborative, project-based web development under the mentorship of Google engineers.

Collaborated with a team of peers to design and implement a web application using Java, JavaScript, HTML and CSS over the course of 10 weeks, leveraging various Google Cloud Platform APIs, including App Engine and Datastore.

Practiced industry best practices such as: contributing to open-source software using Git and GitHub, conducting code reviews with/for teammates, extending an existing codebase, participating in distributed development, designing new components and interfaces and leading them to completion.

positions.title: Backend Dev
positions.description:
Surplus is an app that allows business owners to sell their surplus goods to college students at discounted prices. As a developer at Surplus, I worked on the iOS mobile development team. I helped create a mobile application for the stakeholders and take part in maturing key features.

• 𝗗𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗽𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁: Bridging the front-end React Native code to the Firebase backend and database services.
• 𝗧𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴: Ensured that the code base passed regression testing and maintained consistency.
• 𝗧𝗲𝗮𝗺𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸: Actively partake in scrum meetings and discuss high level requirements using GitHub Project Board.

positions.title: Software Development Team
positions.description:
Student design team based at San Jose State University that designs builds and competes with a battery-electric formula-style race car in the annual international Formula SAE Electric competition. Our team is divided into 6 sub-teams: aerodynamics, chassis, marketing, powertrain, suspension, and software. Our combined effort all goes towards competing in competitions held in Lincoln, Nebraska, and in Barrie, Ontario.

     Software Development Team Involvement: 
     •  Developed my programming skills in C
     •  Learned more about CAN communication and electric vehicle operating systems
     •  Utilized Git/Github, Slack, Trello, Altium's Tasking Compiler, and Linux Bash.
     •  Worked in a team of 2 to develop an under voltage protection handler for our electric vehicle.
     •  Collaborated with the software team leader to develop software in C to ensure the safety of our 
         driver.

     Marketing Team Involvement: 
     •  Led a team of 4 multidisciplinary engineering students to develop a business/design concept 
         summary of our electric vehicle.
     •  Main duties of this team involve contacting companies for funding, and organizing events for 
         our team.

positions.title: Fellow @ Facebook
positions.description:
Braven's Accelerator program is a sustainable model for increasing the odds that students from underrepresented backgrounds earn a college degree and successfully transition into strong first jobs. Braven prepares individuals for the increasingly competitive, globalized job marketplace.

     • Developed skills critical to success in the 21st-century workforce such as operating and 
       managing, effective communications, and problem-solving.
     • Obtained critical knowledge of professional work environments and developed authentic 
        leadership
     • Received mentoring from various Facebook leadership coaches.

honors.description: Engineering undergraduates who have earned a 3.65 or higher GPA in at least two contiguous semesters are Dean’s Scholars

projects.title: Autonomous Vehicle Project | Perception Team
projects.description:
SJSU Autonomous Vehicle Club is a new club on campus with the intention of inspiring the field of self-driving vehicles at SJSU. The perception team handles  2D camera perception mainly for obstacle detection. 
     - Utilize Linux (Ubuntu 16.04) to run Robot Operating System (ROS) Kinetic.
     - Utilize OpenCV, Python, and C++ for object detection.

Upcoming goals for the perception team:
     - Running Tiny YOLO on a Jetson TX2 for fast and efficient object detection.
     - Integrating Darknet's real-time object detection with ROS Kinetic.
     - Detection data fusion with a LIDAR obstacle detection.

projects.title: Spartan JCApp | Android Application
projects.description:
Working with 3 software engineering students to deliver a user-friendly and feature-improved contact manager for Android platforms. 
     - Utilizing Android Studio, Java, and Git to develop the Android app and meet the 3-month deadline.
     - Led the team by delegating tasks and outlining a preliminary project plan for our application.
     - Will create a QR code scanning feature, using Java, for a convenient way of adding new contacts.
